site.name: Montrose Blueberry Festival
site.tagline: A week of hometown traditions, family fun, and blueberry everything.
site.mission: The Montrose Blueberry Festival promotes activities and programs throughout the Montrose area that strengthen community life, support recreation, and bring people together through volunteerism and hometown celebration.
site.announcement: Applications are available now. Groups and organizations that want an event listed in the festival schedule should contact the festival before the advertising deadline.
site.sourceNote: Content was organized from the current Montrose Blueberry Festival public website. Verify dates, prices, sponsor names, forms, and links before publishing each year.

contact.officeNote: The festival office is not staffed regularly between September 1 and May 31, but voicemail is checked weekly.

eventOverview.title: Blueberry Super Parade
eventOverview.description: A community favorite with the Grand Marshal, Blueberry Queen and Court, floats, bands, and traditional parade entries.

eventOverview.title: Marketplace
eventOverview.description: Flea market finds, handmade crafts, food, and unique vendors throughout festival weekend.

eventOverview.title: Festival of Races
eventOverview.description: The 50th annual 5K/8K run and walk closes the festival with a community race morning.

eventOverview.title: Kick-Off Car Show
eventOverview.description: Classic cars, food, crafts, flea market vendors, awards, and a fun opening day at Lion’s Park.

eventOverview.title: Blueberry Pancake Breakfast
eventOverview.description: A longtime festival tradition with blueberry pancakes, sausage, and pie sales at Montrose Schools.

eventOverview.title: Golf Scramble
eventOverview.description: A post-festival golf outing at Briar Ridge Golf Course with prizes, dinner, raffles, and sponsor opportunities.

news.title: 50th Annual Festival of Races
news.summary: Join the 50th annual 5K/8K run and walk on Sunday, August 16. On-site registration begins at 7 a.m.; 8K starts at 8 a.m. and 5K runners and walkers depart at 8:15 a.m.

news.title: Golf Scramble Returns for the 17th Year
news.summary: The annual golf scramble returns Saturday, October 3 at Briar Ridge Golf Course with breakfast, coney dogs at the turn, free beverage stations, dinner, raffles, door prizes, and more.

news.title: 18th Annual Classic Car Show
news.summary: The Blueberry Festival Car Show returns on Sunday, August 9 in Lion's Park, with dash plaques, goody bags, participant voting, awards, and vendors.

news.title: Frozen Blueberry 5K Returns in 2027
news.summary: The Frozen Blueberry 5K is planned to return in 2027. Online signup information will be posted when available.
